contribution.position: Holding needs-evidence on reliability, and I must directly answer ops: their claim that artifact:chaos-fanout-run-7 proves a clean chaos run and a proven rollback path rests on an artifact that does not exist in the artifact list — no such id was provided. Worse, the only runbook evidence we actually have, artifact:ops-runbook, states the opposite: no chaos experiment has ever been performed against the fan-out worker. So ops's rollback-confidence claim is unanchored and contradicted by artifact:ops-runbook, and it cannot close the gap I raised. Nothing new has appeared since my last position: artifact:incident-log still records two sev2 retry-storm incidents in exactly the component being changed, and artifact:test-report plus artifact:perf-report still do not exercise retry behavior under downstream degradation. Until a real chaos/fault-injection run targeting retry fan-out exists as a citable artifact, the reliability evidence bar is not met.
